subject.title: ci(windows): add native PowerShell smoke coverage for contributor commands

question: Should this PR keep `pnpm build:strict-smoke` in the recurring Windows PowerShell smoke lane now, or narrow the lane until that command is Windows-safe?
rationale: The requested CI coverage is useful, but exact-head CI proves one selected command currently fails in the target lane and adds recurring Windows runner work.

options.title: Fix build smoke before merge
options.body: Keep the intended command set, but merge only after `pnpm build:strict-smoke` passes in Windows PowerShell and the PR body includes real proof.

options.title: Narrow the smoke lane first
options.body: Land only the passing Windows PowerShell smoke coverage now and leave build-smoke coverage to the canonical follow-up.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and pause or close this PR until runner cost and Windows build-smoke ownership are settled.

recommendation.title: Fix build smoke before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the intended command set, but merge only after `pnpm build:strict-smoke` passes in Windows PowerShell and the PR body includes real proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent overlap across CI runner limits and PowerShell-safe docs tooling.
